reader.requirement: At --std 85, a WRITE statement that specifies ADVANCING PAGE (BEFORE or AFTER, with or without the word ADVANCING) together with the [AT] END-OF-PAGE / EOP phrase must be refused, in either phrase order; the NOT END-OF-PAGE phrase is named separately by SR8, so ADVANCING PAGE with only NOT AT END-OF-PAGE is not covered by SR7.
reader.edition-search: Read BindWrite's END-OF-PAGE block and CheckWriteEopAdvancingPage: no DialectLevel/CobolVersion/ConstructRegistry test; grep -rn 'EndOfPage|END-OF-PAGE|EOP' in WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler filtered for edition|DialectLevel|Construct|Version found only VersionConformancePass's WRITE lock-phrase placement checks (2002/2014 constructs, not this rule) and the phrase-order check. data.Edition is used only as the diagnostic sink.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no (the 1985 SR7 and 2023 SR18 are the same obligation; the diagnostic cites ISO §2023:14.9.51.3 SR18 at every edition, including --std 85)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers AFTER ADVANCING PAGE with AT and NOT AT END-OF-PAGE; BEFORE PAGE, the EOP spelling, AFTER PAGE without ADVANCING, NOT-only and non-PAGE advancing are not exercised (probed here)

probes.printed: error COBOL0861: WRITE ADVANCING PAGE with an END-OF-PAGE phrase: the two shall not both be specified in a single WRITE statement (ISO §2023:14.9.51.3 SR18)
error COBOL0861 and COBOL0900 'AT END-OF-PAGE after NOT AT END-OF-PAGE ... requires COBOL-2002'
probes.expected: refused: SR7 and the 1985 format's phrase order
accepted: only NOT END-OF-PAGE, which SR7 does not name (SR8 names it separately)

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.4.7.3 SR7  (4.7.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR7
OK  §1985:VII.4.7.3 SR8  (4.7.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR8

reader.notes: The check is edition-independent and refuses every ADVANCING PAGE + AT END-OF-PAGE/EOP form probed at --std 85. Diagnostic-face observation only: COBOL0861 (and COBOL0860) cite ISO §2023:14.9.51.3 SR18/SR19 at --std 85, where the RECORD-clause screen cites the 1985 rule via Rule1985 (kb/Work PB5361 pattern); the refusal itself is correct.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:VII.4.7 whole and SequentialIoBinder.cs#BindWrite (the SR18 call reads AnyAdvancePage(adv) = wba.PAGE() and the non-negated EndOfPage phrase) and StatementValidation.cs#CheckWriteEopAdvancingPage. The reader's NOT-only reading holds in the 1985 text itself: SR8 names 'the END-OF-PAGE or the NOT END-OF-PAGE phrase' as two phrases and GR17 says 'imperative-statement-1 specified in the END-OF-PAGE phrase', so SR7's 'END-OF-PAGE' is the AT phrase. Probes at --std 85 (refute-1985-07/c2), all forms the reader did not run: nowd.cob AFTER PAGE (no word ADVANCING) AT END-OF-PAGE -> COBOL0861; both.cob BEFORE PAGE AT EOP + NOT AT END-OF-PAGE -> COBOL0861; noat.cob ADVANCING PAGE END-OF-PAGE (no AT, period-terminated) -> COBOL0861; inif.cob the WRITE inside IF ... ELSE with bare EOP -> COBOL0861; baf.cob the 2023-only BEFORE AFTER pair with PAGE + AT EOP -> COBOL0861 plus COBOL0900 'requires COBOL-2023'. notrun.cob/notrun2.cob: ADVANCING PAGE with only NOT AT END-OF-PAGE compiles and its imperative does not run, while a following ADVANCING 1 LINE NOT phrase does (LC=2); that matches §1985:VII.3.7.4 GR9c (the reset 'implicitly incremented to exceed the value specified by integer-1', a page overflow, which without FOOTING is the end-of-page condition per LINAGE GR1), so GR9 is not broken either. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VII.4.7.3 SR7'; 'OK  §1985:VII.4.7.3 SR8'; 'OK  §1985:VII.4.7.4 GR17'; 'OK  §1985:VII.3.7.4 GR9c'; 'OK  §1985:VII.4.7.4 GR9'. Diagnostic face only: COBOL0861 cites ISO §2023:14.9.51.3 SR18 at --std 85 (the reader already noted it).
